notes.title: Have election results closest to reality
notes.content:
The campaign enters its final week ! But who will win ?

Between the 2nd  and 7th of November, 2016,
there will be 3 winners chosen from players 
who submit their scores on the game website at the end of the game.

The winners will be those whose game produces 
election results  (in terms of numbers of delegates, in realistic game mode)
that are the closest to the actual results of the US presidential election on November 8, 2016.

In case of a tie, the winners will be chosen by a random drawing,

Prize : each winner will receive a free copy of Power & Revolution – Geopolitical Simulator 4 (or a DLC if game already owned)

Score link on game website:  http://www.theraceforthewhitehouse.com/score.php?langue=en
